title: Implement email templates
description: Implement the outreach email templates. Create at least 2 templates (cold outreach, follow-up). Each template is an HTML/text function that accepts business data and returns formatted email content.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 email templates defined in src/lib/email/templates/
Each template exports a function: template(data: TemplateData): { subject, html, text }
Templates reference: businessName, previewUrl, agentName, prospectName
HTML templates use inline CSS (email client safe)
Templates are listed in a TEMPLATES registry object
Verify templates render correctly with sample data

steps.details: Export function `coldOutreach(data: TemplateData)`. Returns subject: 'I built a free website for {businessName}', html: full HTML email with preview link, text: plain text version.
Export function `followUp(data: TemplateData)`. Returns subject: 'Following up — your free site is still live', html and text versions.
Export `TEMPLATES = { coldOutreach, followUp }` registry. Export `TemplateData` type: `{ businessName, previewUrl, agentName, prospectName? }`.

Call `coldOutreach({ businessName: 'ABC Roofing', previewUrl: 'http://localhost:3000/preview/abc-roofing', agentName: 'John' })`. Verify subject, html, and text are non-empty and contain the business name.
